curriculum.desc: Programmes, units, topics and evidence with governance controls.

curriculum.contentSpineDesc: Programme → Unit → Lesson → Objective. The structure everything else attaches to.
curriculum.topicsDesc: Published topics are visible to families.

materials.title: Materials
materials.desc: Methodologies, resources and teaching materials with feedback.
materials.catalogueDesc: Textbooks, workbooks, readers and media. Select a material to manage its units, mappings, access and feedback.
materials.resourcesDesc: Links and worksheets shared with the school.
materials.methodologyDesc: Office curates, staff read — how to teach, not what.
materials.uploadFilesDesc: Upload files to secure cloud storage (replaces Google Drive).

ai.title: AI
ai.desc: AI assistance for teaching, with usage, cost and provider status.
ai.assistantDesc: Reports, remarks, at-risk checks, practice plans, quizzes, assessment tasks, lesson plans and learner help — with provider failover, rate limiting, cost tracking and an offline fallback when no key is configured.
ai.budgetLine: Budget: $/day cap {maxDailyCost} · max {maxTokensPerCall} prompt tokens/call · {requestsPerMinute} req/min per provider. All model output is AI-generated and should be reviewed before use.
ai.askDesc: Pick a task; results include a provider + status badge.
ai.generateDesc: Quizzes, assessment tasks and lesson plans from your curriculum targets.
ai.providersOwnerDesc: Provider metadata only — API keys live in environment variables and never in the database.
ai.usageLogDesc: Recent AI calls across the school.
ai.lessonIdHint: lesson id — uses level targets if empty
ai.providerNote: Keys are read from environment variables only — built-ins use GEMINI_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY; a custom provider uses FSMS_AI_KEY_<SLUG> (upper-cased). Nothing secret is ever stored in the database.

reports.title: Reports
reports.reportingDesc: Progress, academic, attendance, assessment, class, teacher and administrative reports. Heavy CSV exports run asynchronously and never block normal use.

reports.notAvailableDesc: You do not have access to this report, or it has no data.
reports.classEarningsDesc: Expected vs collected vs pending revenue per class.

reports.hintAssessment: Choose a class to view the assessment report.
reports.hintClass: Choose a class to view the class report.
reports.hintCoverage: Choose a class to view curriculum coverage.
reports.exportNote: Queued jobs sit in report_exports and are converted to CSV by an office-role worker. Download the result any time afterwards.
